(ta)༄༅/ /dam pa'i chos sgrogs pa rnams la phan par gdams pa don gnyis grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /gang dag mtshan gyi chos dung ldir ba'i

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dam pa'i chos sgrogs pa rnams la phan par gdams pa don gnyis grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gang dag mtshan gyi chos dung ldir ba'i khongs// srid zhi'i mi mthun rgud pa'i rims bcal nas// dge legs phan bde gsar pa'i mgron rigs rnams// 'gugs byed dkon mchog gsum gyis rtag tu skyongs// thog mtha' bar kun dge ba'i chos kyi sgra// mi zad mgrin las 'jo bas rang gzhan don// lhun gyis grub pa'i skal bzang chos sgrogs pa// kun la phan par gdams 'dir rna ba blogs// de'ang chos sgrogs pa spyi dang khyad par ba rnams la bsgo ba/ mgon po byams pas/ chos rnams thams cad bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su 'du// legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel bcas// de yi dbang gis shākya'i bstan pa ni// 'jig rten khams 'dir yun ring gnas par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa ni bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis su ma 'dus pa med la/ de nyid lo dar du dpal lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong na mngon par dga' ba dang*/ rgyal khab chen po mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal ba 'dab 'byor ba 'dir/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po che dar ba dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams zhabs pad yun du brtan pa dang*/ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams kyi sku tshe bsod nams mnga' thang dpal 'byor rnams cher rgyas su 'byung ba dang*/ chab 'bangs kyis mtshon pa'i yangs pa'i rgyal khams kyi lus can kun gyi rgyud du tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis sbyang phyir/ 'dus tshogs chen por 'jigs byed drug cu dang*/ dkyil 'khor bdun gyi sgrub mchod dang*/ chos sgrogs pa rnams kyis bka' bstan 'gyur ro 'tshal gyi tshogs bsgrags pa'i/ sa skyong bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po nas bsnyen bkur stob pa gang tshe 'dir 'dus pa'i chos sgrogs pa rnams kyis mtshon yul gru gang du gnas pa'i chos 'don pa spyi la dgos pa'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/

dngos gzhi bskyed dmigs kyi rim pa mjug dge ba bsngo ba'i bar gyi bslab bya rnams kho bo'i logs su bris pa la mos na de blta bar bya zhing*/ 'dir skabs su bab pa ni/ spyir yi ge'i bklag thabs 'phags bod mkhas pa'i tshogs mang pos bris pa yod na'ang*/ 'dir yi ge mangs kyis dogs pas mi 'dri mod/ 'dir chos 'don pa rnams la med thabs med pa'i dbyangs gsal yi ge'i 'byung gnas/ yi ge bklag thabs 'thad pa'i phyogs sgrub pa/ mi 'thad pa'i phyogs dgag pa/ 'thad pa bsgrubs pa'i dgos pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni gnas dang byed pa dang rtsol ba rnams las yi ge skye'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar gnas ni/ khog pa mgrin pa rkan dang lce// sna dang spyi bo so dang mchu// zhes dang klog tshul dngos la/ a ku haṭhaka mgrin pa las// i tsu ya sha rkan las byung*// ita eta aita rnams mgrin rkan las// ṛ ṭu ra ṣa spyi bo las// l̥ tu la sa so las 'byung*// u pu wa ny+pa mchu dag las// ur or aur rnams mchu mgrin las// wa yig mchu dang so las 'byung*// rjes su nga ro sna las te// sna dang rang gi gnas las kyang*// sde pa'i lnga pa rnams 'byung ngo*// byed pa bshad pa la/ byed pa lce yi rtsa ba ni// lce rtse can gyi yin par bshad// lce dbus rkan las 'byung rnams kyi'o// lce rtse dang nye steng 'byung ba'i// so las 'byung ba'i lce rtse ste// lhag ma rang gi gnas nyid do// zhes pa ste de dag legs sbyar sngags kyi bklag thabs te/ zhib pa sngags klog gi gzhung rnams nas rgyas par 'byung bas 'dir ma spros so// de lta bu'i legs sbyar gyi bklag thabs de las bod kyi bklag thabs 'byung ba'i tshul ni/ a ni ring thung gnyis dang*/ ku zhes pa'i nang ka kha ga gha nga ste lnga dang*/ haṭhaka rnams ni mgrin pa las 'byung zhing*/ de la byed pa lce rtsa dang*/ rtsol ba mgrin pa phye ba las 'byung ngo*// i ni mgrin pa btsum pa las 'byung ngo*// de bzhin du tsa tsha dza dzha nya rnams lce rkan so rnams sbyar ba las 'byung ngo*// ṛ gnyis dang ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa ṣa spyi bo las 'byung zhing*/

l̥ gnyis dang ta tha da dha na la dang sa za rnams/ lce rtsa dang so nye ba las 'byung zhing*/ pa pha ba bha ma wa ny+pa rnams mchu las 'byung ngo*// bod dang mthun pa ca cha ja lce dbus dang 'brel pa las so// zha dang sha mthun par lce rtsa las 'byung ngo*// gzhan rtsol ba sogs bshad bya mang du yod kyang 'dir go dka' bas ma bris mod/ yi ge'i 'byung khungs dang byed pa de tsam la nges par byas nas/ yi ge de rnams 'dus pa las ming dang tshig gi tshogs kyi 'phul dang mtha' rten dang mgo can gug skyed gna' ru ya btags ra btags sbyar ba dper na dge bsags/ brtan brling*/ mngon lkog sgrun zla/ bskyed bsrings lta bu rnams la rang rang gi sgra thon pa ste sgra zur ma nyams pa chos kyi tshig 'bru rnams gzugs can gzugs med kun gyis thos par 'gyur ba'i skad gdangs bcas yi ge'i bklag thabs rnams las 'byung ba ltar 'don dgos pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa mi 'thad pa dgag pa ni chos spyod bcu'i skabs nas yi ge klog pa zhes ngag gi skad gdangs mthon po bcas sgra dag par klog dgos kyi/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed tshig le'ur byas pa las/ yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang*// nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang*// 'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang*// de sems pa dang sgom pa ste// spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid kyi// bsod nams phung po gzhal du med// zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi skabs nas kyang*/ nyan pa la'ang der 'khod ci tsam yod pa des thos par byed dgos pa dang*/ klog pa la'ang gang gi yi ge'i skye gnas sogs dang mthun par sgra skad gdangs mtho zhing lhang lhang ba nyan pa kun gyis thos par byed nas klog dgos kyi/ ci yang go rgyu med pa'i mgo bsgril mig 'grim byed pa rnams ni g.yo sgyu can gyi 'don brjod do// 'ga' zhig chos sgrogs pa'i tshig 'bru go rgyu med par 'ung zhes pa'i yig phreng gi grangs mgo bsgril byed pa ni shin tu mi 'thad de/

dper na yi ge phreng gcig gi nang du'ang yig 'bru bdun bcu brgyad cu tsam med pa ni mi srid la/ de la 'ung zhes pa gcig gis khyab pa med de gong du bshad pa'i yi ge'i skye gnas dang 'byung khungs kyi klog lugs ci yang med pa'i phyir/ yang 'ga' zhig mchu rtse 'gul tsam dang 'don pa'i sgra skad ci yang mi 'byin par mig 'grim dang mgo bsgril byed pa mthong ste/ de 'dra ni yi ge shes mi shes pa kun gyis kyang mig 'grim de 'dra mi shes pa su yang med pa'i phyir/ chos sgrogs kyi tha snyad mi thob ste/ chos sgrogs kyi ming yang med do// lar sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis yi ge'i bklag thabs kun la de 'dra bshad pa med pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig yig 'bru gsum bzhi tsam 'bod skad lta bu byed kyang*/ de 'bro mthud pa med pa lkog sob bzlas pa lta bu byed pa de'ang yi ge klog pa'i go mi chod de/ yig klog la yig 'bru so so'i sgra zur dang*/ 'phul byed mtha' rten sa dang ra sogs kyi mgo can/ ya btags ra btags la btags zhabs 'greng kun kyang yi ge la yod tshul ltar bklag dgos shing*/ de lta min na yig klog mkhas mi mkhas kyi tha snyad kyang med cing*/ chos sgrogs byas pa'i phan yon chung zhing rang gzhan gnyis ka mgo g.yogs pa'i g.yo sgyu can du 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// yang 'ga' zhig yi ge mkhas pas sgra skad lta bu 'don ma nus kyang sems ma yengs pa yid klog lta bu byed pas chog mod bsams na de ni ma yin te/ gsang sngags zab mo'i bzlas brjod la'ang sems sgom pa bsam gtan dang ma bral bar sngags kyi sgra gong bas tshor tsam bzla dgos par bshad mod/ 'dir ni de dang mi 'dra ste chos sgrogs byed pa'i tshig gi 'bru don te/ mi dang mi ma yin pa kun gyis thos par bzla dgos kyi/ yid bzlas mgo bsgril byed pa de yi chos kyi sgra skad sus kyang mnyan du med de/

g.yo sgyu can gyis chos sgrogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// rig pa tha mal du g.yeng ba'i ngang nas yi ge 'don pa'i skad gdangs sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa/ zhu ba pos zhus pa/ chos rang gi gnas lugs sogs mi dang mi ma yin pa kun gyi rna bas sgra lhang lhang ba thos pa zhig las phan yon thams cad 'byung dgos kyi/ de lta ma yin pa'i lkog sob kyi sgra cung zad re dang mig 'grim byed pa de lta bu ni phan yon cung zad kyang mi 'byung ste/ des na chos sgrogs byed pa rnams kyang bsnyen bkur dang yon 'bul len par 'dod cing*/ sbyin bdag gi dgos pa'i gtso bo bka' lung gi tshig don skad gdangs chen pos dag gsal can du mi 'don pa/ g.yo 'gul 'tsher zhing skad gdangs bteg mi 'dod par/ gsung rab kyi phan yon thams cad chos sgrogs pa rnams kyi g.yo sgyu ri chen pos non pa lta bu'i 'og tu 'gror bcug pa 'di ni/ sangs rgyas bstan pa la gnod tshab 'di las che ba 'byung thabs ma mchis so// des na gtsang dbus khams gsum du bla ma slob dpon gyi rigs su gtogs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang slob ma smin pa'i phyir dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i bya ba thams cad dang*/ 'dus tshogs mang pos cho ga chos spyod kyi 'don brjod thams cad kyang*/ rang gzhan 'gro ba kun gyis thos par 'don dgos par 'gyur na/ khyed cag chos sgrogs pa rnams la chos kyi sgra don cung zad kyang go rgyu med par mgo bsgril mig 'grim kho na byed chog pa 'di/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcom pa su las gnang ba thob pa yin smra dgos so// smra rgyu med na za 'dod g.yo 'gul 'tsher ba'i bya ba mkhan de bstan pa la gtan nas mi gnas par gzhan du byol zhig gsum pa 'thad pa sgrub pa'i dgos pa ni/ chos tshul bzhin bton pa ni/ ston pas kyang*/

lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad// grul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams las// 'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam pa// thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan no// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ des na gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po las kyang mdo sde de nyid kyis mtshon nas theg chen gyi mdo rnams gang du bzhugs shing spel ba dang mchod pa'i rgyal po sogs yod pa der rgyal po chen po bzhi sogs kyis skyong bar byed pa'i tshul rgya cher 'byung zhing khyad par du/ bcom ldan 'das mi'i rgyal po gang gi yul du mdo sde'i dbang po 'dzin pa'i dge slong chos smra ba de dag mchi bar 'gyur ba'i yul de dag tu gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di yang bsnyen par 'gyur ro// btsun pa bcom ldan 'das nam mi'i rgyal pos gser 'od dam pa mdo sde'i dbang po'i rgyal po 'di mnyan te thos nas mdo sde'i dbang po 'di 'dzin pa'i dge slong de dag gi phyir rgol ba de dag las kun tu srung bar bgyid/ yongs su skyob pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ yongs su sbyong bar bgyid na/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhis mi'i rgyal po de'i yul thams cad na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kun tu bsrung bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o// zhes sogs mdo sde du ma nas 'byung ba ltar rang re rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab dag gsal can du bklags pa na sgra skad ma nyams pa chos sgra lhang nge ba bsgrags na bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha klu dri za sogs kyang*/ sngon ston pas chos kyi rnam grangs re re gsungs pa la'ang lha klu sogs sde brgyad kun gyis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di su zhig gis 'dri'am klog pa sogs la bdag cag rnams kyis rtag tu bsrung ba dang*/

bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ chos kyi sbyin bdag bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams bskyed pa la sogs pa'i mthun grogs bgyi bar khas blangs pa bzhin du byed cing*/ gnas skabs kyi nad gdon bar chad zhi ba sogs bsam don kun kyang de dag gis bsgrub par khas blangs pa'i phyir ro// bstan pa la mi dga' ba'i bdud dang mu stegs 'dre gdon gdug pa can sogs/ chos kyi sgra lhang lhang ba thos pa'i 'khor yug dpag tshad kun tu 'bros par 'gyur ba sogs/ chos kyi rnam grangs rgya cher gsungs pa rnams 'dir yi ger 'drir ma ldang mod/ tshul de dag thugs la bzhag par zhu/ slar smras pa/ ming tshig yi ge'i 'byung sgo byed pa dang*// rtsol ba mgrin pa mchu yi 'byed 'dzum sgra// ma nyams lhang nger sgrogs pa'i chos spyod pa// yon mchod phan bde sgrub pa'i mchod gnas nyid// dag gsal tshig 'bru rna bas mnyan du med// kha cig sgra med mig gi ltad mos tshim// 'ga' zhig 'ung sgra gcig la mgo bsgril mang*// ngal dub dogs pa'i g.yo sgyu'i chos sgrogs pa// chos sgra dbyar gyi rnga gsang lhang nge bar// 'khor 'das lha srung mdongs mtha' ldan pa rnams// srung skyob dga' ba'i gar bcas phan 'dogs kyi// spu sdug ngoms pa dam chos bden pa'i mthu// de skad smras la g.yo can dgyes min yang*// gzur gnas dpyod ldan dga' ba'i ga zha 'byin// pad+ma'i bsrung la sha sbrang mgu min yang*// sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa rangs pa'i glu chung len// 'di sbyar dge bas yangs pa'i 'jig rten khams// bde 'byung chos kyi sgra dbyangs snyan pas khyab// lus can mtha' dag bde ba de rgyu bcas// spyod pa'i skal ba bzang por reg gyur cig /ces dam pa'i chos sgrogs pa rnams la phan par gdams pa don gnyis grub pa'i bcud len zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rnam 'dren bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po sa skyong blo gros rgya mtsho pa'i bka' lung gis chos sgrogs pa spyi dang bye brag pa rnams/

sa nye ring gang du bzhag kyang chos 'don gyi tshig gi sgra skad gang yang thos rgyu med pa lkog sob dang mgo bsgril byed pa 'di rnams la chos kyi sgra dag gsal lhang lhang 'byin dgos pa'i bsgo blags 'di ltar bris zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ thu mi'i lugs srol 'chang ba ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung rung gi yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bya bas lhun grub steng du bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
